title: James Davolos on The Royalty King Podcast: Is the Market Wrong on TPL? Following the Post-Election Sell-Off (November 2026)
gist: A short podcast description: Horizon Kinetics' James Davolos and Benjamin Demase of The Royalty King Podcast discuss what the market is misreading about the Texas election and a data center moratorium after TPL's post-election sell-off. Most of the page is fund disclosures, which show Horizon Kinetics' board-level, possibly sale-restricted stake in TPL.

insights.claim: Horizon Kinetics' James Davolos, on The Royalty King Podcast in November 2026, framed the post-election sell-off in Texas Pacific Land (TPL) as a potential market misreading of the Texas election and a data center moratorium and their implications for West Texas.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Flags a Horizon Kinetics view that TPL's post-election weakness may be mispriced; the write-up gives no supporting data, so check the full episode before acting.
insights.quote: what the market is misreading about the Texas election, the data center moratorium, and what both mean for West Texas
insights.locator: In this episode, James Davolos and Benjamin Demase

insights.claim: A data center moratorium tied to the Texas election is presented as a key swing factor for West Texas land and royalty value, in a discussion of whether the market is wrong on Texas Pacific Land after a post-election sell-off.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Watch Texas data center policy as a catalyst for Permian landowners like TPL, whose data-center and power-related optionality is what's being repriced.
insights.locator: In this episode, James Davolos and Benjamin Demase

insights.claim: Horizon Kinetics is not a neutral commentator on Texas Pacific Land: Peter Doyle sits on TPL's board under a Board Representation Agreement, and TPL is held in client accounts and funds including the Inflation Beneficiaries ETF (INFL).
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: Discount the bullish TPL framing for the manager's concentrated, board-level stake.
insights.locator: Peter Doyle is a member of the Board of Directors

insights.claim: Because Horizon Kinetics holds investment and voting discretion over a substantial share of TPL and MIAX voting shares, the adviser may be deemed an affiliate and could be restricted in selling TPL or MIAX shares.
insights.speaker: Horizon Kinetics
insights.so_what: A large holder that may be limited in selling reduces exit liquidity, but it also keeps that holder from adding supply when the stock sells off; keep it in mind when sizing TPL.
insights.quote: the Adviser and the Funds might be restricted or limited in selling shares of TPL or MIAX
insights.locator: Because it has investment and voting discretion
